title.narrative: Enhancing the institutional capacity of South Africa to coordinate green hydrogen activities of the Hydrogen Society Roadmap

description.narrative: The Readiness Programme seeks to enhance the readiness of South Africa#s Government to coordinate and implement green hydrogen related activities of the Hydrogen Society Roadmap.The programme further aims to develop a 'South-African International Hydrogen Energy Centre', promote enabling regulatory framework for environmental and social safeguards, conduct a pre-feasibility study for decarbonising Ground Support Vehicles at Or Tambo International Airport in cooperation with Airports Company South Africa, and develop a Guidebook for hydrogen innovation and R<(>&<)>D commercialisation for publicly-funded IP. The project commenced at 14.07.2023 and planned for completion at 30.04.2026.
